verdict.rationale: Pika is an AI creative platform with an API, an MCP server and multi-step apps, so a buyer could fairly ask about versioning automations. The evidence pack documents no way to version, review, or roll back automations or workflows. The developer-platform counter-check states the corpus has no versioning, deprecation, or changelog text, and that /changelog answers 404; this concerns API lifecycle rather than user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
